title: Sheet C·01 drawing
summary: Each interior page opens on hero C's cell nav (the open section underlined) and then a sheet from Kelwin's drawing set, with no film. The title row uses the shared C head: red-square label, an 88px uppercase title with the light 300 accent 'HEARS.', the 48px rule under it, and a note cell with the lede and the shared door pair. FIG. 1.1 shows the founder's three-piece mark exploded as 1px isometric plates, with the red plane installed in K1 (Narrative). Beside it, a stacked index of the page's sections sits over a key–value spec keyed A–D to the drawing's callouts. The overview statement gets its own title and note row, and the manifest begins as full-width cell rows.

reference.borrowed: Joby's engineering summary sheet: a single top hairline, the page's own section index stacked large with the active item in ink and its siblings muted, a 'Fig.' caption heading a large 1px line drawing of the product, and a ruled key–value spec table. Drawing, index and spec are composed as one sheet with plenty of air.
reference.kelwin: Mirrored onto the C anatomy under the site's cell nav (lockup, five tracked-caps cells, a SHEET C·01/03 cell, the outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗ cell): the drawing takes cols 1–8 over a dashed construction grid, and the index and spec take cols 9–12. The aircraft becomes Kelwin's own subject: the founder-master mark (K1, K2, K3 in their 152-unit proportions), extruded as 1px plates at exactly 30° and exploded above a dashed datum. One flat red plane is installed in K1, because this is the Narrative Systems sheet. Lettered callouts A–D on orthogonal leaders key to spec rows, and hovering a row turns its leader --accent. Joby's index becomes '[01] OVERVIEW · [02] MANIFEST · [03] EVIDENCE · [04] ENGAGEMENT' in 32px wide caps, with the active tab inverted. Above it sits the shared C head: a red-square sheet label, an 88px uppercase title flush bottom-left with 'HEARS.' as the light accent, the 48px rule, and a note cell with the 20px lede and the shared door pair (red 'C9·R3 · Fixed scope · 10 WD / Initiate System Audit ↗' and a ruled 'Contact →'). Below the drawing, an overview row repeats the title/note anatomy: '[01] OVERVIEW · WHAT IT IS', a 40px two-tone statement with its light accent line, and the prose in the note cell. Then come cell rows for S·01–S·02 (mono ID · service · scope · [ARTIFACT] chip), a ticker of the three capability sheets, and the segmented title block.

motion: entrance, in drafting order: the frame verticals and crosshairs fade in (300ms), the nav cells and their rules draw in order (40ms stagger), and the cell borders draw in raster order. The title lines wipe in from left to right, the 48px rule draws under them, and the cell IDs type on at 24ms per character. The lede, door pair, tabs and spec rows fade in sequence. The overview statement wipes in line by line (about 0.9s), its prose fades in, and the manifest head and rows follow.

the drawing plots (about 2.4s): the construction grid and datum fade in, then each plate's faces plot by stroke-dashoffset, bottom to top (K3, K2, K1, 70ms per face). The elevation and footprint dimensions plot next, then the leaders, then the lettered tags. Last, the red plane drops into K1 (opacity plus an 8px settle, 400ms): the 'installed' beat.

demo of the scroll-linked index: at about 3.6s the inverted tab steps from [01] OVERVIEW to [02] MANIFEST, and the manifest rows take the --panel highlight in raster order, 120ms apart. At about 5.1s it hands back to [01], the resting state.
ambient: none, apart from the X/Y readout on the right frame edge.

interaction: the X/Y readout follows the cursor. Hovering spec rows A–D turns that letter's leader, node and box --accent on the drawing. Hovering a manifest row fills it --panel. Nav cells, the contact cell and the outlined audit request invert (--fg fill, --bg text), and the red audit cell deepens on hover.

on the live site: the [01]–[04] index is sticky and steps with scroll through Overview, Manifest, Evidence and Engagement. The drawing plots once when 50% visible. prefers-reduced-motion shows the fully plotted final state with [01] active.
notes: Nav + interior page header + first body beat as one 1392px sheet (under the 1400px cap), so the manifest is cropped to S·01–S·02 and its head reads 'S·01–S·02 of 07 · continues'. Coherence pass: added the site nav (the task requires it on nav/hero/interior), moved the head onto the shared grammar (Mona caps label, --display-tracking, the light accent at 300, the rule under the title instead of in the note cell), unified the door pair and title block, set captions at the .18em label tracking and raised the tab titles to 32px. Per the logo correction, FIG. 1.1 draws the founder's three-piece mark rather than a four-layer stack, and K1/K2/K3 map to the three capability sheets C·01/C·02/C·03. Red: the founder head marks (label square and rule), the action cell and the single installed plane. Callout values come from the source: C·02 carries the language, C·03 measures it, a six-week install is followed by a retainer, and seven services each ship an artifact.
